title: Translative covering densities of order n log n
summary: For every sufficiently large dimension n , we construct a centrally symmetric convex body whose translative covering density exceeds $`c n\log n`$, where c > 0 is absolute. This disproves the existence of a universal linear upper bound and matches the order of Rogers' upper bound.
family_title: The optimal order of convex-body covering density

review.reason: Constructs convex bodies with translative covering density of order n log n.
